history.sg_progress: UNAMI notes that the preliminary asset disposal plan pertains exclusively to serialized equipment with an equipment master record and does not encompass real estate assets. As real estate assets are not serialized, they fall outside the scope of the preliminary asset disposal plan. The management of real estate assets remains under the responsibility of the designated Real Estate Asset Manager at the Mission, in accordance with established procedures and corresponding Umoja records. To ensure transparency and enhance the accuracy of the asset disposal process, the Mission has recorded its real estate assets in Umoja. The Mission considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure by the Board.
